Meet Angelica, a 10 week old, 10 pound (as of 9/22), adorable Pit Bull mix. She is great with other dogs and friendly!

If you would like to adopt this Rockstar, please visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!

www.pupstarzrescue.org

**Please note that puppies can grow .5-2.5lbs a week based on their breed**
